elements.name: ntl-card-grid
elements.description: Responsive CSS Grid layout for cards.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Number of equal-width grid columns. Defaults to 3.

attributes.name: columns-tablet
attributes.description: Number of grid columns in tablet mode. Defaults to 2.

attributes.name: columns-mobile
attributes.description: Number of grid columns in mobile mode. Defaults to 1.

attributes.name: min-width
attributes.description: Minimum card width. Enables intrinsic auto-fit grid wrapping when set.

attributes.name: max-width
attributes.description: Maximum card width. Defaults to unset.
